rules.name: Reanimate Archers - Ranged Ability
rules.description: 2 Surge : The defender receives 1 blight token.

rules.name: Carrion Lancers - Melee Ability
rules.description: 1 Surge : Add Mortal Strike if the defender has a blight token.

rules.name: Carrion Lancers - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose 1 unengaged enemy unit at range 1-5 and in line of sight. That unit recieves 1 blight token.

rules.name: Host of Crows
rules.description: Each unit in your army is treated as having the available upgrades in the row of its costing table with the next highest cost.

rules.name: Ardus Ix'Erebus - Melee Ability
rules.description: This attack is treated as having the Surge abilities (both Melee and Ranged) of allies at range 1-3.

rules.name: Forbidden Lore of the Shadow Council
rules.description: Your army can include 1 non-unique unit from any other faction. After setup, that unit receives 2 blight tokens.

rules.name: Ankaur Maro - Ranged Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surges: Remove 1 wound.

rules.name: Ankaur Maro - Skill Ability
rules.description: Add up to [Stable Rune] full trays to a Waiqar infantry unit at range 1-5. Then, suffer wounds equal to the number of trays added.

rules.name: Death Knights - Passive Ability
rules.description: While defending, subtract 1 Mortal Strike.

rules.name: Wraiths - Passive Abilitiy
rules.description:
During a March or Shift you may ignore any number of units and terrain.

After you perform a March or Shift, perform a Reform.

While defending, before the attacker rerolls, reroll up to [Stable Rune] dice.

rules.name: Lord Vorun'thul - Melee Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Unique Surges: The Defender recieves 1 stun token.

rules.name: Lord Vorun'thul - Skill Ability
rules.description: Place your unit at range 1 and in line of sight of its current position, engaged with an enemy; then square up as if you collided. Transform into "Vorun'thul the Cursed," then perform a Melee Attack. Remove 1 die for this Melee Attack.

rules.name: Vorun'thul the Cursed - Melee Ability
rules.description: Unique Surge: Gain Brutal 1 for this Melee Attack.

rules.name: Vorun'thul the Cursed - Skill Ability
rules.description: Place your unit at range 2 of its position and not engaged with an enemy, transform into "Lord Vorun'thul," then receive 1 stun token.

rules.name: Ardus Ix'Erebus - Melee Abiity
rules.description:
Add 1 white die. 

This attack is treated as having the Surge abilities (both melee and ranged) of allies at range 1-3.

rules.name: Executioner - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose a wounded figure in an enemy engaged with you and remove it.

rules.name: Mistlands Saboteur - Skill Ability
rules.description: Discard 1 non-figure upgrade card from an enemy engaged with you.

rules.name: Necromancer - Skill Ability
rules.description: If there are empty slots in your trays, place up to [Natural Rune] new figures corresponding to this unit's card in the empty slots folowing the rules for placing units with Regenerate.

rules.name: Deathcaller - Skill Ability
rules.description: Spend a blight token from an enemy at range 1-5 and in line of sight to cause that enemy to suffer [Unstable Rune] wounds.

rules.name: Captivating Hexer - Passive Ability
rules.description: Enemies engaged with you cannot perform a Shift.

rules.name: Fallen Hero - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Add a Artifact to this unit's available upgrades. 

When this figure is removed, discard 1 Artifact upgrade that is equipped to this unit.

rules.name: Ankaur Maro (Infantry Upgrade) - Skill Ability
rules.description: Add up to [Stable Rune] full trays to another Waiqar infantry unit at range 1-5. Then, this unit suffers wounds equal to the number of trays added.

rules.name: Ankaur Maro (Cavalry Upgrade)
rules.description: Add up to [Stable Rune] full trays to a Waiqar infantry unit at range 1-5. Then, this unit suffers wounds equal to the number of trays added.

rules.name: Lord Vorun'thul (Infantry Upgrade) - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Lord Vorun'thul (Infantry Upgrade) - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose 1 unengaged enemy at range 1-5 and in line of sight. Then that enemy performs a speed-[Stable Rune] Shift in a direction of your choice. This Shift cannot be used to enter or exit terrain.

rules.name: Vorun'thul the Cursed (Siege Upgrade) - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Tactical Dummer - Passive Ability
rules.description: You do not receive panic tokens for disengaging from enemies.

rules.name: Aggressive Drummer - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a Move, threat it as modified by Charge. You do not receive panic tokens for failing to collide with an enemy unit during a Charge.

rules.name: Marching Drummer - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a March, you may treat it as modified by Turn.

rules.name: Unhallowed Wind - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before or after your activation, you may exhaust this card to cause each enemy at range 1-[Stable Rune] to receive 1 panic token.

rules.name: Combat Ingenuity - Passive Ability
rules.description: The number of Surge that precedes your Surge abilities is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1. This does not affect Surge+ abilities.

rules.name: Lingering Dead - Passive Ability
rules.description: While there are figures in your unit, do not remove empty trays from your unit until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Support Carrion Lancer - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose 1 unengaged enemy unit at range 1-5 and in line of sight. That unit receives 1 blight token.

rules.name: Front Line Carrion Lancer - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: One Surge : Add Mortal Strike if the defender has a blight token.

rules.name: Vorun'thul the Cursed (Infantry Upgrade) - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Ardus' Fury - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: Add 1 Surge.

rules.name: Regenerative Magic - Passive Ability
rules.description: The number of Surge that precedes your Surge abilties is reduced by 1 to a minimum of 1. This does not affect Surge+ abilities.

rules.name: Violent Forces - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Your Ranged Attack rolls a number of white dice equal to [Natural Rune] instead of [Unstable Rune].

Your Skill Ability adds [Unstable Rune] trays instead of [Natural Rune].

rules.name: Undying Hate - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Before deployment, choose 1 enemy. That enemy receives the "Mark of Vengeance" condition.

Mark of Vengance: While defending, if the attacker has "Undying Hate" equipped, it may replace 1 die with a white die.
Before you are destroyed, discard "Undying Hate" from each engaged enemy.

rules.name: Faces of the Fallen - Melee Ability
rules.description: If an enemy has been destroyed during this game, add Morale.

rules.name: Thirst of Bilehall - Melee Ability
rules.description:
After this melee attack, if the defender suffered at least 3 wounds, choose 1:
-Discard 1 wound.
-Discard 1 bane.
-Ready 1 upgrade card.

rules.name: Entrancing Gaze - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose 1 enemy at range 1-5 and in line of sight. Then that enemy performs a speed-[Stable Rune] Shift in a direction of your choice. This Shift cannot be used to enter or exit terrain.

rules.name: Blighted Vexillum Bearer - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you collide with an enemy or an enemy collides with you, that enemy receives 1 blight token.

rules.name: Raven-Standard Bearer - Passive Ability
rules.description: The initiative of your red actions is decreased by 1.

rules.name: Deathmist Banners - Passive Ability
rules.description: After your activation, each enemy at range 1 suffers [Stable Rune] damage.

rules.name: Bloodied Tatters - Passive Ability
rules.description: When an enemy engaged with you suffers 1 or more wounds, place 1 wound token on this card if it has fewer than 2.

rules.name: Bloodied Tatters - Melee Ability
rules.description: Before spending surges, if there are 2 wound tokens on this card, add morale

rules.name: The Duskblade - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surge : Reduce the defender's defense by 1 for this attack.

rules.name: Obcasium's Gauntlet - Melee Ability
rules.description:
You may exhaust this card to cause the defender to receive the "Death's Grasp" condition.

Death's Grasp: (Unique) Before each End Phase, you suffer [Stable Rune] wounds.

rules.name: Dimodian Blades - Melee Ability
rules.description:
Exhaust this card to gain the following:
-Precise [Stable Rune] for this Melee Attack if you do not have Precise.
-Lethal [Unstable Rune] for this Melee Attack if you do not have Lethal.
